season_garden_20_001.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_001.text: The twentieth paid afternoon began at the agreed time. The responsible staff had assessed the current ordinary conditions and retained the planned finite handover. Yue brought her private notebook, with the single offered fallen leaf still pressed between clean pages, and kept it among her own belongings. Qiu brought her private folder and the untested drawing she would retain. Neither arrived early for unpaid preparation. The useful staff packet had remained at the site overnight under its owners' custody. Today they would check and complete the actual returns, rather than gather a new collection of memories.

season_garden_20_002.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_002.text: The hall worker opened the current general instructions and the separate receiver question list. Public wording described the approved ordinary cloth and stock tasks, current places and staff consultation route. The internal list guided this finite acceptance. It was not another public instruction or a continuing review job for the helpers. Yue checked that the current sheet's dates matched the worker's record. Qiu checked that the comparison copy stayed separate from current use. Professional staff retained their own records and authority, including the right to revise the practical arrangement after the women left.

season_garden_20_003.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_003.text: Su brought the new term's treasury account, keeping its one hundred twenty copper labor allocation and forty copper materials allocation distinct. The old twenty four copper trial had already closed and supplied no money or authority to this account. Nineteen sessions had occurred: eighteen full three hour sessions and the storm session that ended after two. Each helper had worked fifty six hours before today. This final full session would bring each to fifty nine. The unfinished hour remained unpaid and unscheduled, with no free makeup or invisible extra day inserted to restore a tidy sixty.

season_garden_20_004.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_004.text: The responsible worker asked for the actual small stock before beginning the final check. Blank general sheets, the loose practice board and accepted removable cloth samples were present in their specified places. The permitted summary copy already released to its receiver appeared as an authorized movement, with its source conditions attached. It was not missing stock. Staff carried the heavier bundle. Yue and Qiu handled only the assigned loose items within their shoulder and elbow limits. No private family object or patient form entered the count to make the packet seem more complete.

season_garden_20_005.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_005.text: They read the current methods against the actual places one last time. The drying rack, general return tray, waiting section and blank stock place matched the accepted words. The consultation route named the responsible worker, and no line still said to ask the helpers. Qiu checked the parenthetical note corrected yesterday. Yue checked the ownership caution. The worker retained these specific observations in her own practical record. The women did not certify the site, every future reader or clinical safety. Their contribution concerned general wording and approved small tasks under the receiver's current authority.

season_garden_20_006.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_006.text: The loose practice piece was ready for the final actual handover in the format selected on the fifteenth afternoon. The first work in that format had already happened, and subsequent ordinary use had supplied revisions. No alternative format had been performed privately. Yue set the current source note beside the receiver's list, outside the public instruction. Qiu checked the actual selected destination in the work record. The delayed recall now had a practical purpose: describe and finish the handover they had truly done, with its limited evidence and finite end, rather than merge possible histories.

season_garden_20_007.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_007.text: The hall worker confirmed which current participation was accepted for the selected format. Willing people could ask about the approved ordinary methods, decline participation or leave according to their own duties and wishes. No clinical exercise or private account would supply an example. The women would not assess a participant's body, treatment, grief or family choices. Yue put her notebook farther from the working space so the pressed leaf remained private. Qiu left the untested drawing in her own folder. The actual method materials were enough for the finite handover.

season_garden_20_008.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_008.text: Their final source representation would keep the chosen setting and practical observations attached to the accepted sheet. It would name staff ownership and the limits of the approved loose methods. The worker would complete her own current acceptance and retain the useful materials. The helpers' paid availability would end with this twentieth session. Qiu looked at the practice loop and waited for the actual selected activity, rather than adding whichever alternative seemed likely to leave a more satisfying last impression. Yue felt the same temptation and let the source record answer it.

season_garden_20_009.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_009.text: After the selected handover, the responsible worker retained the accepted current sheet and its actual source note. The unchosen format remained unperformed, and no final account credited its imagined advantages. Yue returned the loose practice materials to their specified places. Qiu placed the source representation in the worker's folder, separate from public current wording and from retained comparison copies. The finite activity had reached its real end. Professional staff would continue ordinary maintenance, while the women would no longer supply an assumed standing service simply because their instructions remained useful.

season_garden_20_010.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_010.text: A willing ordinary user asked where to find the sheet later. The responsible worker gave the current location and consultation route. Yue did not add her personal address or invite questions between sessions. Qiu pointed to the practical heading after the worker permitted it. The user found the sheet and continued with another task. That small encounter showed current access for one person in this setting. It did not require a broad statement that the handover would never need revision or that all future questions had now been answered by the women's careful work.

season_garden_20_011.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_011.text: The receiver compared the physical small stock with the list. The practice board retained its ordinary scratch and had been accepted in that condition. The frayed loose tie removed yesterday had followed the worker's specified waste route. Its suitable existing replacement remained with current practice stock. Blank sheets matched the count once the permitted released copy was accounted for. Yue handed over the accepted list. Qiu checked the actual receiver's name by role in the record. No personal purchase was needed to make used stock look untouched, and no new materials fee followed.

season_garden_20_012.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_012.text: The worker specified the final paper custody in plain terms. She retained the current instruction, practical source note, authorized release record and small stock list. She retained one comparison copy for her own maintenance purposes, clearly outside current use. Surplus general drafts had gone to authorized reuse stock. The internal acceptance list remained her own finite review record. Yue and Qiu kept their private notebooks and untested drafts. Patient records and clinical exercise forms stayed with professional healers. The child's original drawing and pinwheel stayed private with their actual owners, with no fresh permission for public copies.

season_garden_20_013.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_013.text: Yue checked her personal belongings against that custody statement. The pressed leaf rested in her own closed notebook, offered for private keeping by its actual owner from the separate intact established plum. No living tree had been damaged to supply it. Qiu's drawing stayed privately retained and untested. Neither object would be inserted into the general handover as a moving illustration. Yue thanked the worker for accepting the useful materials. She did not offer the private notebook to prove what the season had meant. The actual custody was complete without that disclosure.

season_garden_20_014.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_014.text: At the agreed pause, both women rested according to their current needs. Yue supported her shoulder and let the worker's packet remain on the worker's table. Qiu settled her elbow comfortably and drank from the ordinary supply. Professional medical decisions remained with healers. The completed practical handover did not change either woman's qualification or remove the limits that had shaped her work. Yue felt pleased and tired at once. Qiu said she wanted the end to feel clearer than fatigue. Yue answered that clear custody and tired bodies could both be real without one explaining the other away.

season_garden_20_015.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_015.text: The cook asked whether they would be staying for an ordinary meal after the paid session. The invitation came without serving duty or an unpaid extension. Yue checked her actual family plan and said she would leave for the supper already arranged. Qiu chose the same departure because she had accepted time with her sister. The cook received both answers without disappointment they had to repair. The women could value the invitation and decline it. The garden's finite end did not require every relationship in the room to produce one shared last occasion.

season_garden_20_016.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_016.text: A family member passed through and wished them well. She offered no public account of what the grandmother's death had meant, and neither helper requested one. Yue remembered the willing words at the earlier gathering, whose actual farewell priority had expired with its fourteenth session use. Today did not reopen that choice or perform the unchosen improvement. The ordinary hall continued around them. Qiu returned a cup to its accepted place. Useful work could finish in a room still containing grief, meals, impatience and people whose private lives had not agreed to become the helpers' conclusion.

season_garden_20_017.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_017.text: When the pause ended, Su asked whether any borrowed small material still remained with the women. Yue had none. Qiu had none. Their permitted personal reminders were their own papers, limited to general planning and free of private patient information. Staff originals had stayed at the site. The borrowed family cloth had already returned to its owner through the actual accepted route. Su recorded that completed custody instead of making another promise to sort matters later. The final financial return could now proceed with useful materials already accepted and personal things clearly outside the allowance.

season_garden_20_018.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_018.text: The gardener arrived with the selected planting's current professional record and actual receipt. The first choice had remained live through purchase, later observations and today because it produced different living uses and costs. The annual bed or young plum would receive its corresponding final general account. Trained judgments and ongoing care belonged to the gardener. The helpers would not touch the plants or borrow an observation from the unchosen history. Yue checked the source decision once more. Qiu set the general summary sheet where it could be copied within their actual comfortable movements.

season_garden_20_019.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_019.text: The established owner's plum was separate from either selected first planting. Its naturally fallen gifted leaf was a private object offered outside the treasury purchase. Yue would keep it in her notebook without a public display or medicinal claim. The current plant account therefore needed no adjustment for the leaf. Qiu checked that no private family history had entered the general summary. The actual selected bed or young tree could keep its own ordinary record. The owner's gift could remain meaningful to Yue without being credited as an outcome the project's planting choice had produced.

season_garden_20_020.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_020.text: Su prepared each woman's final three copper payment while the gardener checked the selected material bill. The final full session's agreed work had occurred within its three hours, including ordinary accepted pauses and the planned finite handover. No early private preparation or late extension would be added. The branch's final account would pay each helper for that completed time and return the unused allowance through the authorized treasury. Yue checked her own prior total of fifty six. Qiu checked hers. Both reached the same actual labor history, although the selected planting would change the materials balance.

season_garden_20_021.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_021.text: The final account would state only the selected purchase. Annual stock and suitable light materials had cost three copper; the young plum and required planting materials had cost eight. Both histories shared the completed six copper bench repair. No extra garden purchase had occurred later, and existing approved stock had supplied the general instruction work. The women had paid their ordinary personal paper, food and family costs themselves. Su kept those private costs outside the allowance. The account would close one hundred sixty copper through actual wages, actual materials and returned money, with no donation invented to absorb the remainder.

season_garden_20_022.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_022.text: Yue waited while the gardener opened the selected record. She did not need the final plant observation to vindicate every private reason she had chosen that path. Qiu kept the unchosen wish visible in her own mind without giving it a receipt or a fictional bed. The current finite term had supported one accepted first planting, with staff care continuing beyond the helpers' availability. The final account would now follow that real history. Its returned balance would belong to the authorized treasury, rather than becoming a new fund the women could spend because leaving money unused felt unfinished.

season_garden_20_023.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_023.text: The selected account had now been completed through actual payment, recorded spending and returned allowance. Su retained the closed new term ledger and the receipt for the returned money. The gardener retained the plant record and current general summary, with ongoing care under staff responsibility. The hall worker retained the approved practical methods and actual source note. Yue and Qiu held their own fifty nine copper each in earned garden wages and their own private belongings. No new grant had opened, and no unfinished unpaid hour had been transformed into a gift of labor at the end.

season_garden_20_024.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_024.text: Su read the labor closure once more. Nineteen full three hour sessions and the one two hour storm session made fifty nine hours for each helper. At one copper per actual hour, each had received fifty nine, making one hundred eighteen combined. Two of the one hundred twenty labor copper had returned unused. There had been twenty sessions across ten weeks, with no makeup session. The arithmetic preserved the actual lost hour. It did not accuse the women of failing to finish sixty hours that the weather and staff stop had never allowed.

season_garden_20_025.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_025.text: The responsible worker gave a final current acknowledgment of the useful materials received. Her finite acceptance review ended with the completed twentieth handover. Later ordinary maintenance and any future revision belonged to professional staff under their own arrangement, not a promised continuing review by the helpers. Yue asked whether a specific correction remained assigned today. None did. Qiu asked whether the private drawing was wanted. It was not part of the accepted packet, and she retained it. The end was concrete enough to leave without requiring the women to feel indifferent, cured or fully confident.

season_garden_20_026.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_026.text: The bench owner met them on the permitted route and asked whether they had finished their agreed work. Yue said they had completed the actual returns and account. The owner wished them a good supper and did not ask for another repair. Qiu thanked her for the ordinary conversations. Yue thanked her for the one fallen leaf, which remained privately pressed in the notebook. The established plum was still intact under its own care. No further leaf, cutting or keepsake was requested. The useful work and the personal gift could leave through their different completed permissions.

season_garden_20_027.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_027.text: Yue looked once toward the selected planting without supplying an extra observation of her own. The gardener's current record held the actual facts, and qualified staff retained the future care. Qiu kept the gauge closed. The old lost shade and the grandmother's absence remained parts of their private experience, neither restored by a final balance nor converted into a failure of the modest planting. The women could leave one living use under care and one useful method with its receiver. That was the finite result they had actually agreed and completed, even while their feelings exceeded it.

season_garden_20_028.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_028.text: They said goodbye to the professional workers without offering an extra day. Current general questions would follow the staff route named on the accepted sheet. Patient care and clinical decisions stayed with healers. Private family objects stayed with their owners. Yue's notebook and Qiu's folder stayed with the women. The return receipt remained with Su. Each actual thing had its proper custody. Yue felt the urge to check the table again and asked herself whether a specific object was unaccounted for. None was. She let the completed receiver record answer the urge for today.

season_garden_20_029.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_029.text: On the ordinary route out, Qiu asked whether Yue wanted company for the shared portion. Yue checked her shoulder and said yes, then named where she would turn toward her family supper. Qiu named her own turn toward the sister visit. Their finite agreement with the garden had ended, but their relationship could continue through actual invitations and answers. Neither made a vow to remain available whenever the other felt uncertain. The offered walk was small and real. Yue carried the private notebook comfortably within her own plan, without displaying the leaf to make the departure meaningful.

season_garden_20_030.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_030.text: Qiu said she would probably think of a better sentence later. Yue said she might too. The accepted current sheet belonged to its receiver, who could revise through future use. The women could keep private ideas without turning later thoughts into an unpaid obligation to return. Qiu laughed about the unfinished drawing and decided it could wait until she wanted. Yue decided the pressed leaf could remain between pages. Their choices afterward needed no proof that they had learned to stop caring; they simply needed room to belong to their own lives.

season_garden_20_031.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_031.text: At their turn, Yue and Qiu parted with the next meeting still to be arranged. Both had accepted family plans, rest needs and wages of their own. The garden remained under professional care with materials received and the one hundred sixty copper allowance fully accounted for. The private leaf remained with Yue, naturally fallen and freely offered from an intact established tree. No patient paper or child's keepsake had been copied into public use. Yue turned toward supper, carrying concern, affection and a finite completed contribution without making any of them a promise of endless labor.

season_garden_20_032.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_032.text: The later receiving place would hear a permitted general account of the season's work, with source conditions and owners attached. It would receive no notebook, family original, patient form or untested drawing. Yue's pressed leaf stayed in her own pages, and Qiu's personal notes stayed with Qiu. Professional records remained with their owners. The women had finished twenty accepted garden sessions and returned the unused allowance, while rest and relationships continued on their own terms. Yue kept walking toward the next real conversation, without asking the completed garden work to supply an ending for everything she still felt.

season_garden_20_open_01.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_01.text: The actual selected source was the optional open table first performed on the fifteenth afternoon. The responsible worker had accepted that setting for approved ordinary cloth and stock methods, with willing participation and the freedom to leave. Today she confirmed a final finite open table within the paid session. Yue and Qiu arranged only the accepted loose practice materials. No clinical exercise, patient story or family keepsake became a prop. The bounded working circle had not been performed under this source choice, and its imagined advantages would not appear as evidence in the final account.

season_garden_20_open_02.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_02.text: The worker stated the current ordinary scope to the willing people who approached. The loose cloth release, general stock places and ownership caution were the methods available. Installed supports and heavier repairs remained staff work, while medical decisions remained with healers. Yue read the plain heading from her supported position. Qiu kept the practice object within her elbow's comfortable movement. Someone chose to watch without trying. Someone else chose to pass on. The optional table did not turn observation into required participation or make departure a failure the women needed to record by name.

season_garden_20_open_03.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_03.text: A willing user read the current release instruction and tried the approved small action with the loose practice piece. She left the fixed support untouched and asked where a damp piece should wait. The responsible worker directed her to the current named place, and the reader found the matching line. Yue recorded the practical question and answer without an assessment of the person's body or ability. Qiu checked the current words against the actual action. The attempt supplied limited evidence for this loose method in this setting, rather than a certificate for all future materials.

season_garden_20_open_04.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_04.text: Another willing person asked whether a privately owned paper could be placed with general returned stock. The worker explained the consultation route and authorized return process without asking anyone to disclose private contents. Yue pointed to the ownership caution after permission. Qiu used a blank practice sheet to keep the example general. The person said the distinction was clear here and then left for another duty. No private request, patient record or household account entered the demonstration. The useful boundary could be taught through permitted blank stock without acquiring the story behind an actual paper.

season_garden_20_open_05.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_05.text: One participant preferred the earlier drying place and said the new wording felt less familiar. The responsible worker explained the current accepted arrangement and retained authority over it. Yue did not treat familiarity as proof that the old instruction should return. Qiu showed the current place name on the sheet and the present label. The person found them consistent. The open table had revealed a real transition question. The source note would record that specific practical clarification, with no claim that every person welcomed the change or that public agreement had validated the site.

season_garden_20_open_06.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_06.text: The accepted table reached its stated closing time within the twentieth session. Yue said the current sheet would remain under the hall worker's ownership, and ordinary questions would follow that staff route. Qiu returned the loose practice object to its accepted place. A person asked whether another table would happen next week. The responsible worker said no continuing helper arrangement had been accepted. Future staff activity would have its own actual decision. The women made no private offer to extend the term, and the optional participants owed no satisfaction with its finite end.

season_garden_20_open_07.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_07.text: The receiver reviewed the actual source account: optional open table, approved ordinary loose methods, willing participation and specific practical questions answered under staff authority. The current instructions had been revised through ordinary use since the first table. Yue checked that the account did not become a claim of clinical teaching or broad community expertise. Qiu checked that it did not name private attendance circumstances. The worker retained the source note with its conditions attached. The women could approve the accuracy of their limited contribution without certifying the professional worker's whole public operation.

season_garden_20_open_08.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_08.text: The worker accepted the current method packet after the actual final open table and completed its corresponding finite check. She retained the public current sheet separately from her internal question list and source record. The participants had received the permitted general method in this setting, and the staff receiver now held the materials for ordinary continuation. Yue handed over the practice list. Qiu checked the accepted storage once more. The handover belonged to real receiver actions rather than the writers' declaration that the open format must have succeeded because people had gathered near it.

season_garden_20_open_09.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_09.text: Yue still imagined the bounded circle might have allowed longer questions, but no bounded circle had been performed in this history. Qiu left that thought out of the record. The final open table had supplied actual observations, and the unchosen format remained an untested alternative under this source decision. The women did not hold an extra private circle to make the account more complete. The finite agreement contained no promise to teach in every possible way. Their final representation could be accurate because it named the one setting and work they had really used.

season_garden_20_open_10.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_open_10.text: The open table ended with the current accepted sheet held by the responsible worker and loose stock returned to its specified places. No participant list or private form traveled with the packet. Yue kept her notebook, including the pressed leaf, among her own belongings. Qiu kept the untested drawing privately. The selected first handover and today's final recall now formed one actual history with its revisions and limits. They returned to the shared final inventory and account, with the open setting completed and no ongoing helper service promised beyond the twentieth session.

season_garden_20_bounded_01.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_01.text: The actual selected source was the bounded working circle first performed on the fifteenth afternoon. The responsible worker had accepted that setting with willing hall workers for approved ordinary cloth and stock methods. Today she confirmed a final finite circle within the paid session, using the same bounded practical purpose. Yue and Qiu arranged only the accepted loose practice materials. No clinical exercise, patient story or family keepsake became an example. The optional open table had not been performed under this source choice, and its imagined audience would not be credited in the final account.

season_garden_20_bounded_02.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_02.text: The worker confirmed the actual willing participants without making the circle a compulsory test. One worker could remain for the whole practical check, while another needed to leave earlier for ordinary duties. Yue read the current scope from her supported position. Qiu kept the loose object within her elbow's comfortable movement. The approved tasks concerned cloth release, general stock places and ownership consultation. Heavier supports remained staff work, and medical decisions remained with healers. The circle's small size did not entitle the helpers to discuss anyone's private care, household or reasons for attending.

season_garden_20_bounded_03.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_03.text: A willing worker read the current release instruction and tried the approved loose action. She left the fixed support untouched and placed the damp cloth in the current specified waiting place. The responsible worker observed and confirmed the limited sequence. Yue asked which words had guided the move rather than evaluating the person's body or skill. Qiu noted the practical answer without a private attendance record. The attempt supplied evidence about this ordinary method with this accepted object and current wording, rather than a qualification for the women to teach other materials or clinical exercises.

season_garden_20_bounded_04.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_04.text: The worker who would leave early asked about general paper awaiting an owner. The responsible person explained the consultation route and authorized holding place without revealing any private request. Yue pointed to the ownership caution after permission. Qiu kept the practice example blank. The participant found the relevant line, then left at the agreed time for her actual duty. Nobody asked her to complete another attempt for the writers' satisfaction. The bounded circle retained useful feedback without turning a practical departure into evidence that the woman was less willing or less able.

season_garden_20_bounded_05.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_05.text: The remaining participant said the new drying place still felt unfamiliar despite the corrected wording. The responsible worker explained the current accepted arrangement and retained its practical authority. Yue compared the present label with the sheet. Qiu read the corrected parenthetical note. The participant found the names consistent and said she would continue using the current place. The circle had revealed a real transition question, not a need for the helpers to restore the old arrangement. The source account would name that limited clarification without claiming unanimous approval of every site's change.

season_garden_20_bounded_06.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_06.text: The finite discussion reached its stated end within the twentieth session. Yue said the current sheet would remain with the responsible hall worker and ordinary questions would follow that staff route. Qiu returned the loose practice object to its accepted place. A participant asked whether the women would remain available for private questions afterward. They said their accepted helper term ended today. Professional staff would continue their own responsibilities, and any future arrangement needed its own actual decision. Neither woman offered an unpaid later meeting to make a practical ending feel more generous.

season_garden_20_bounded_07.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_07.text: The receiver reviewed the actual source account: bounded circle of willing hall workers, approved ordinary loose methods and specific practical questions answered under staff authority. The current wording had been revised through ordinary use since the first circle. Yue checked that the account did not imply the women had taught clinical exercises or acquired professional standing. Qiu checked that it did not name private participant circumstances. The worker retained the source note with its conditions attached. The women approved the accuracy of their limited contribution, while the receiver's broader professional responsibilities remained her own.

season_garden_20_bounded_08.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_08.text: The worker accepted the current method packet after the actual final bounded circle and completed its corresponding finite check. She retained the public current sheet separately from her internal question list and source record. The willing workers had received the permitted ordinary method in this setting, and the receiver now held the materials for continuing maintenance. Yue handed over the practice list. Qiu checked the accepted storage once more. The handover belonged to real attempts, corrections and receiver actions, rather than a claim that a small circle must have achieved agreement because everybody had been close enough to listen.

season_garden_20_bounded_09.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_09.text: Yue still imagined the open table might have reached people who never joined this circle. Qiu kept that thought out of the record because no open table had been performed in this history. The bounded work supplied its own actual observations. The unchosen format remained an untested alternative under the source decision, with no invented participants or outcomes. The women did not add a final open demonstration to repair the imagined loss. Their finite agreement contained no promise to teach through every possible setting, and the accurate account needed the one method they had really chosen.

season_garden_20_bounded_10.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_bounded_10.text: The bounded circle ended with the current accepted sheet held by the responsible worker and loose stock returned to its specified places. No private participant list or clinical form traveled with the packet. Yue kept her notebook, including the pressed leaf, among her own belongings. Qiu kept the untested drawing privately. The selected first handover and today's final recall now formed one actual history with its revisions and limits. They returned to the shared final inventory and account, with the bounded discussion completed and no continuing helper availability promised beyond the twentieth session.

season_garden_20_annuals_01.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_annuals_01.text: The final selected planting account began with the annual purchase actually made on the sixth session. Approved annual stock and suitable light materials had cost three copper. The gardener retained the receipt's connection to the modest seasonal bed and its continuing care. The young plum had not been bought, planted or given a fictitious final observation in this history. Yue copied the permitted general facts from the actual current record. Qiu kept the unchosen tree wish outside the bill. A finite decision could remain consequential without pretending it had supplied both living futures through one allowance.

season_garden_20_annuals_02.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_annuals_02.text: The gardener's current observation still confirmed sixteen seedlings. Two plants retained their formed buds, and one small flower had now opened on another established plant under the responsible person's identification. Yue looked from the permitted route and let the first actual color remain a limited finding. It was not a promised full display or a bloom delivered for the earlier farewell. Qiu copied the gardener's exact general description. The four retained seeds remained in proper storage, with no further sowing authorized. The helpers did not add more plants to make the final count appear triumphant.

season_garden_20_annuals_03.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_annuals_03.text: The gardener retained the trained growth judgment and ordinary ongoing care. The modest annual bed would follow its accepted seasonal cycle under staff's rota and water arrangement after the helper term. Yue would not water privately, scatter the retained seeds or provide a continuing visitor update. Qiu checked the public direction named the responsible gardener. The first opened flower could be enjoyed without making the women custodians of every later bloom. The actual selected account needed its current source conditions and care owner, rather than a promise that all the hope invested in the bed would now be fulfilled.

season_garden_20_annuals_04.speaker: narrator
season_garden_20_annuals_04.text: The general summary named the actual observation date and limited finding without a memorial designation. No private patient record, family history or child's drawing entered it. Yue remembered the grandmother liking yellow and left that private association with herself. Qiu checked the summary against the gardener's current record. The responsible person accepted it and retained both summary and detailed care account in their proper scopes. The helpers' accurate copying did not certify plant health or site use. It handed a useful ordinary description back to the professional who owned the continuing record and judgment.

season_garden_20_annuals_05.speaker: narrator
